# E0212: a minor version requires a field its predecessor left optional

A field the predecessor left optional may be absent from its instances; a minor
version that requires it rejects those instances.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a?: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a!: int
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0212]: a in schema 0.1 was optional and is now required
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 a!: int
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema 0.1 is a minor version, so it must accept all data schema 0.0 accepts
   = help: make the change compatible, or make this version 1.0
```
